info.title: Drive English Profile and Media Access Contract
info.description: Schema-version5 design contract. Actual registration, handler wiring and validation are tracked per operation in implementation records; this description does not assert deployment or service availability. User JWT + active subject/session binding authorizes both anonymous and permanent profiles. Owner/epoch from request never grants access. Mutation operation_id equals Idempotency-Key. Event batch <=50 and UTF-8 <=256 KiB; other personal mutation <=16 KiB. Current-vehicle explicit settings/current lesson win at merge; absent fields restore from account. Histories remain distinct; all-profile history deletion preserves auth/settings. Logout affects only current vehicle/session. No public Data API grants on personal tables. Profile preferences and session control are independent of the learning-history epoch; still enforce active owner/session and their own versions. Audio URL issuance is read-only and uses fresh operation IDs for renewal. S2 draft revision5, schema_version5; packaged schema3 consumers require an explicit coordinated upgrade. Reject missing/old schema versions (422); never default missing exposure to unexposed. Preserve existing histories and initialize unsupported legacy exposure coverage as unknown. Existing /v1 paths denote the initial service surface. This design is not runtime/DB validation. Draft4 was not deployed; new schema5 writes require spoken-language evidence and role/language metadata. Packaged snapshots and manifests must match the canonical contract before adoption; runtime support is tracked separately. No silent English eligibility or clean-exposure defaults.

post.description: Create/resolve one persistent profile from verified anonymous or permanent Auth. Repeated first-use requests reuse owner; never reset data on transient failure.

UserBearer.description: Verify signature, issuer, audience, expiry, subject and active server session binding. Publishable key is not sufficient; caller metadata cannot authorize owner.

InstallationId.name: X-Installation-ID
InstallationId.description: Random installation context bound to verified session_id. Not identity/authorization on its own.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Equals operation_id. Owner + session/endpoint + key scopes receipts; same key with different immutable payload is a conflict.

ResumeRef.description: listening references an unfinished checkpoint; practice references an unfinished lesson OR a completed lesson with pending_feedback_attempt_id. Reading a result is not a presentation ACK. Completion/ACK clears only a pointer still targeting that lesson.

resume_version.description: Independent optimistic version for active_resume. History deletion, merge or completion clearing the pointer advances this version.

profile_kind.description: Derived from verified identity/ownership, never speaker identity or user_metadata. One active app profile; no automatic OS profile link.

BootstrapRequest.description: Creates/resolves one server owner for the verified auth subject. An arbitrary pre-existing provisional UUID never grants access; return an authorized mapping for local first-use records only.

SettingsPatch.description: Only keys under set are explicit choices; server updates explicit_fields. Untouched initial defaults do not override target settings at merge. Omitted keys remain unchanged. Learning-history epoch changes do not reject a same-owner preference patch; expected settings version still applies. The response reports the current history epoch.

CheckpointInput.description: Pinned selection ownership/content refs must match. Main/followup asset/duration match server metadata and position<=duration; article_offer has null asset/duration and position0. Caller cannot declare completion.

LessonInput.description: Client may request only valid transitions. Completion, judgement and validated feedback are server-owned; phase feedback_pending/retry_offer must match stored attempts/results. Never accepts prior exposure/status/assessment. Help arrays describe observed current-lesson support, not generated candidates; server validates against delivery evidence. Persist/restore dialogue business progress separately from live timers. New lesson false; existing same lesson uses monotonic OR, validated at current owner/epoch. Explicit record version conflicts do not erase true.

AttemptInput.description: First has null previous ID; retry references same-owner same-task feedback. New recording uses new UUID. An unassessable recording does not spend a valid turn. Flush witnessed support receipts before acceptance; the server derives exposure at this boundary and unions confirmed support separately. Missing help arrays never prove unexposed. Offline/legacy uncertain exposure remains unknown. Original-language evidence is checked independently from form. Server derives English eligibility; a normalized English string cannot consume a valid turn. Prefer resolving one language confirmation before immutable AttemptAccepted; unresolved API input follows the unassessable branch.

CheckpointEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

LessonEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

AttemptEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

SyncRequest.description: UTF-8 request <=256 KiB; split by both count and bytes. Validate all events before atomic batch commit. Stale epoch rejects the entire batch; no implicit adoption of the current epoch.

LessonRecord.description: Read-only authoritative lesson state, anchors, end reason and undelivered feedback. New explicit practice has a new lesson UUID. prior_example_exposure is the server lesson_start assessment; new lessons reset valid turns, never the canonical exposure history. help_received/support_refs are validated current-lesson reports; pending/generated support is separate. Persist/restore dialogue business progress separately from live timers. New lesson false; existing same lesson uses monotonic OR, validated at current owner/epoch. Explicit record version conflicts do not erase true.

SyncPage.description: If client epoch is stale: reset_required true, records empty, cursor null. Client discards old local history/outbox before requesting the new generation. Never expose data from a different owner.

MergePrepare.description: Anonymous source only. Flush source learning/deletion outbox and confirm ACK before prepare; source cursor must cover local immutable submissions. Server derives source, never accepts arbitrary source owner IDs.

MergeIntent.description: One-use source proof, default lifetime 300 seconds. Keep proof and source session reference in protected flow journal until success/rollback; never log them. Expiry preserves both profiles and requires a fresh prepared proof.

MergeComplete.description: Verified permanent target plus source proof. Recheck source/target epochs and source sync watermark in one transaction. Existing signed-in A-to-B switches are not merges.

MergeReceipt.description: Same target can retry the same completion. Keep target privacy_epoch stable; merge is not deletion. Source owner retirement blocks its old JWTs. Source explicit settings/ongoing resume win; absent values fall back; distinct history remains. Cancel old-owner inflight processing and resume migrated attempts under target authorization. Transfer the source explicit unfinished or undelivered-result active_resume pointer, not the record with the newest timestamp; otherwise preserve the target pointer. Advance target resume_version in the merge transaction. Move stream/selection/run/observation/completion/lesson state and pending presentation, preserving real repeats; do not union independent runs. Source current pending-result resume may win.

DeletionRequest.description: Resolve an already committed operation receipt before stale-epoch rejection. For a new operation require the current history epoch. Replaying a receipt never decreases the client current epoch; fetch current profile context before any history upload.

DeletionReceipt.description: Epoch increments once per operation; delete history/attempts/feedback/progress/queues and invalidate operations. Keep auth/settings and minimal receipt metadata. Offline devices apply on next authorized profile sync; already-offline devices are not claimed erased immediately. Clear active_resume and advance resume_version in the deletion transaction. Delete all new coverage/completion/selection/terminal/presentation learning records; old generation cannot recreate them.

LogoutRequest.description: Must equal verified JWT session_id for this installation. Use isolated captured old session context; never send the new anonymous bearer to revoke the previous session. Repeated receipt lookup is allowed only for the same verified subject/session/key even after own binding retirement. History epoch staleness does not prevent closing the same verified session; this endpoint accepts no history write. Same subject/session can retry only the existing logout receipt.

LogoutReceipt.description: Retires only the app binding of this session. SDK provider signOut(LOCAL) and local clearing are separate effects; do not claim global provider revocation. Offline client journal blocks old-owner UI/sync immediately and retries on the isolated prior context.

AudioAccessResponse.description: HTTPS outside explicit loopback development. URL expiry is not a content version; new range/seek renewal uses a fresh operation_id and revalidates rights. No immediate revocation of already issued bytes is claimed.

ResumeSelection.description: Explicit resume selection after the referenced record has been acknowledged by sync. Verify owner, current history epoch and expected_resume_version atomically; null clears the pointer. Same operation/payload returns the original receipt before version checking; different payload conflicts. A stale receipt cannot lower locally observed epoch/version. A version conflict preserves all history and the current local task, and does not blindly overwrite a newer selection. Background outbox replay must not infer or select a target from timestamps. Mark explicit start/resume/practice or the active queue next transition locally, flush its referenced records, then send this operation. Deletion/merge/logout boundaries invalidate unsent previous-context selection intents.

StreamInput.description: Create stream metadata only. No future item array, total count, duration or product item limit. Mutations of the current head are server-owned.

StreamEvent.description: Conditional metadata create only; existing same ID/hash is duplicate, conflicting payload is conflict.

StreamRecord.description: Actual selected history only. Read wrapper version is the optimistic head version.

CheckpointRecord.description: Pinned selection ownership/content refs must match. Main/followup asset/duration match server metadata and position<=duration; article_offer has null asset/duration and position0. Caller cannot declare completion.

SelectionRecord.description: Immutable one-article selection. Current article refs/settings stay pinned; next selection re-queries live eligible catalog. Ordinal is not an index into a preallocated item array. settings_snapshot is the saved preference snapshot pinned at the original selection, not an overwritten effective mode. On explicit_format_change, content_ref carries the one-time mode and format_change_source anchors saved work; copy the source followup policy. previous_selection_id is the actual stream head, not necessarily the source selection. Never update ProfileSettings.

PlaybackRunRecord.description: One verified session/installation writer, one immutable main asset. Server derives confirmed frontier. A new-device resume copies only the server-confirmed prefix at run start; later old tail never changes that initial snapshot. Other runs remain independent history. An inherited frontier already at duration never generates another completion merely by run creation; only a new actual qualifying extension creates a completion.

PlaybackObservationInput.description: Append-only continuous actual playback interval [start,end). Validate 0<=start<end<=server asset duration and writer/session/owner/epoch. Close intervals at seek/stall/interruption; never bridge unplayed time. Apply only contiguous observation sequence. An observed range extends frontier only when start<=current frontier; never union a previously skipped tail retroactively. Unknown does not advance.

ListeningCompletionRecord.description: Server derived once per qualifying run; frontier==duration on one pinned main. Preserve real repeated runs; automatic exclusion is article_id exists across current-profile/epoch completions. Neither endpoint/EOS nor followup nor comprehension is proof.

PlaybackObservationEvent.description: Immutable conditional create; duplicate UUID/hash returns original receipt, different payload conflicts.

NextArticleRequest.description: Create StreamInput through sync first. Select only at a real article boundary/explicit request, not speculative prefetch. Atomically lock profile epoch + stream head; one next per expected head. Return same persisted receipt for the same operation; different simultaneous head requests conflict. Current topics OR, catalog published_at DESC/article_id tie; automatic excludes completed and already visited articles in this stream. Explicit replay requires explicit user intent. Check latest access again at playback.

NextArticleResponse.description: Selected creates one selection + initial checkpoint atomically. Client stores receipt then selects resume via the versioned resume API. A stale result never instructs current playback or lowers local epoch/version. No-candidate is not a network error or blanket claim all articles were heard.

PlaybackRunStart.description: Explicit playback start/resume establishes one run writer and immutable main. New run inherits only currently confirmed prefix of that same checkpoint/main. A new replay checkpoint starts at0. Do not merge distinct checkpoint/run portions. Later observations from another run cannot alter current UI/checkpoint or inherited prefix. Bind actual main playback only; followup/offer does not create main observation. No new completion is produced by copying an already-complete prefix.

LessonFinishRequest.description: Only explicit retry refusal for the current validated retry_offer and feedback/first anchor. Silence, STOP, failure or privacy interruption is not terminal. Do not create a retry or success. Validate active session/current epoch before any cached learning receipt; duplicate in current epoch is checked before version. Clear resume only if still this lesson, atomically. Explicit refusal also acknowledges the matching current feedback as an explicit user action; clear only that pending feedback atomically with terminal reason and conditional resume cleanup. Preserve the first validated content_success: sufficient content with language_form remains true; insufficient/incorrect remains false. retry_outcome stays null (not assessed), with no extra content success. A refusal can acknowledge its matching feedback but never an optional hidden/unplayed example.

LessonPresentationRequest.description: Acknowledge the matching pending feedback only after actual parked presentation, verified voice completion or explicit user response. Callback sent/GET result is not delivery. Unknown Gleo lifecycle cannot be synthesized. Version/matching pending guard prevents old ACK clearing newer feedback/resume. This acknowledges feedback only. The explicit array references independently recorded matching observed tickets; empty is allowed. Never infer complete-example exposure from all support_issued fields, hidden components, whole-page visibility or generic refusal.

AttemptRecord.description: Read-only accepted submission plus server-derived attempt_acceptance exposure assessment. Client answer payload stays immutable; exposure assessments have independent revisions. It is not accepted as AttemptInput. Authoritative status is derived by the server; AttemptInput cannot write it. Non-English/unverified stored diagnostic attempts never consume valid first/retry.

FormatChangeRequest.description: Explicit current-article one-time replay only. Flush source checkpoint first. Verify source belongs to this stream/profile/epoch and its checkpoint version, separately from stream head CAS. Resolve approved sibling only in the same pinned bundle/source snapshot; arbitrary target refs are not accepted. A request to the already selected mode conflicts. Atomically save new selection + main checkpoint at position0 + stream head + receipt. Do not inherit another mode/run prefix, mutate preferences, erase old work/completion, or change resume implicitly. Unavailable/withdrawn target leaves original work intact.

FormatChangeResponse.description: One persisted explicit_format_change selection and initial main checkpoint; source snapshot/article must be identical, target mode differs, main position0 and active_run_id null. Start the new run with frontier0 through the existing run API only after current output gates and explicit versioned resume selection. Stale response is storage, never a playback instruction.

PracticePresentationPrepare.description: Register exact approved/server-generated support components BEFORE potential display/voice. Server stores a prepared presentation, verifies owner/epoch/installation/task/question/artifacts and original context, and opens the same canonical exposure row if complete_example is included. Preparation is not exposure or received help. Without a durable registered grant, complete-example presentation waits for connection; previously registered grants remain uncertain until observed. New generic reads never authorize output. Select exact role/language refs from PracticeSupportManifest; no guessed ref names. question_meaning has kind=null but its observed ref/role is still stored; it is not a fact hint or complete-example exposure.

PracticePresentationRecord.description: Read-only durable ticket and observed status. Server retains original installation/context hash and causal lineage privately. Contains no live output grant on sync. Any unresolved full-example ticket makes negative exposure proof unknown; expiry is not no-delivery evidence.

PracticePresentationTicket.description: Persist ticket before rendering; current owner/window/safety/output grant must still be checked locally. Original context echo binds subsequent witnessed observations; it is never a current-output permission after navigation/restart.

PracticePresentationObservation.description: Immutable witnessed observation of this ticket, not a client exposure flag. Completed proves every listed artifact was actually provided through an environment-verified route, including exact example text; split tickets when only some components will appear. A generic feedback response/decline, CallbackSent, queue acceptance or guessed output end is not proof. not_presented_verified needs positively verified cancellation before ANY component output; a client flag/timeout/expiry alone cannot clean uncertainty. Validate current storage owner/epoch and original installation/context/artifact; a genuinely journaled same-epoch observation may arrive after navigation without changing lesson pending state/resume. Old-epoch callbacks never recreate deleted records.

PracticePresentationReceipt.description: Updates only delivery/exposure facts. Never consumes a valid answer, alters semantic content_success/terminal reason, clears another pending feedback or selects active_resume. Same payload retry returns its receipt only at the current authorized epoch; no state/version downgrade from an old receipt.

DialogueProgressObservation.description: Immutable actual HINT_METHOD completion fact. Existing same-owner/current-epoch lesson required; no upsert. OR only its dialogue business flag, independent of lesson phase/version; never change valid anchors/terminal/pending feedback/resume. Validate original output evidence and dedupe output instance. Old epoch/absent lesson rejected.

DialogueProgressEvent.description: Append-only witnessed business event through existing sync, not a stale LessonInput phase update. Same UUID/payload idempotent. Receipt references current lesson ID/version; delayed event can persist true after a phase advance without reverting that phase. New first offline sync can already restore true after the create/observation order is applied.
